map.按身高推算：坐姿桌高≈身高×0.46、椅面高≈身高×0.26、屏幕中心高≈身高×: By height: sitting desk height ≈ height × 0.46, chair height ≈ height × 0.26, screen-center height ≈ height × 0.71, desktop depth about 70 cm for computer use; standing desk height ≈ height × 0.62, screen-center ≈ height × 0.95.

For reference in selection; an adjustable model is more stable.
map.比例为什么这么定？: Why are these ratios set this way?
map.基于坐姿肘高与视线高度的统计均值（约身高 0.46/0.71），属经验推荐区间，: Based on statistical means of sitting elbow height and eye-sight height (about height 0.46 / 0.71), these are empirical recommended ranges; individuals with different arm/leg proportions can fine-tune.
map.身高超范围怎么办？: What if my height is out of range?
map.公式适用于 150–200 cm 多数人群；极高/极矮者按比例推算后再实测手肘与: The formula fits most people 150–200 cm; for very tall/short, compute by ratio then measure actual elbow and sight height.
map.桌高≈身高×0.46、椅高≈身高×0.26（坐姿）: Desk height ≈ height × 0.46, chair height ≈ height × 0.26 (sitting)
map.电脑办公桌面深度建议 ≥70cm，书写 60cm: Desktop depth ≥70cm recommended for computer work, 60cm for writing
map.标准：手肘 90°、平视屏幕上沿、腰部有支撑: Standard: elbows at 90°, monitor top at eye level, lumbar supported
Ergonomic rule of thumb: seated desk height = height × 0.46, seat height = height × 0.26, screen center height = height × 0.71, and desk depth is 70 cm for computer work and 60 cm for writing and reading; for standing work, desk height = height × 0.62, screen center height = height × 0.95, depth 60 cm, seat height 0. Recommended viewing distance = monitor inches × 2.54 × 1.5 to 2.0 (cm); when height ≤ 0, prompt for a valid height
map.居家/办公选购：按身高与电脑、书写、站立三种场景，给出桌高、椅高、屏幕中心高与桌: Home/office purchase: initial desk, chair, screen-center and desk-depth references from height and computer, writing or standing use.
map.个体校准：可填实测椅面高、肘高、眼高，优先采用实测值，减少仅按身高比例带来的偏差: Individual calibration: enter measured seat, elbow and eye heights to override height-ratio estimates and reduce error.

map.只能作为初始参考。个体腿长、臂长、坐姿与屏幕厚度不同，建议用实测椅高、肘高、眼高: Only as an initial reference. Leg length, arm length, posture and screen thickness differ; fine-tune with measured seat, elbow and eye heights and prefer adjustable furniture.
map.书写场景为什么没有视距？: Why is there no viewing distance in writing mode?
